# CPA Ireland - Key Dates

> Source: https://www.cpaireland.ie
> Site: CPA Ireland
> Scraped: 2026-04-16

# Key Dates for students, their employers, and training firms on the proposed amalgamation of Chartered Accountants Ireland and CPA Ireland.

#### August 2024

22 to 30 August - CPA Ireland Foundation, Professional and Strategic Level examinations. This will be the final sitting for Foundation and Professional examinations.

#### September 2024

1 September - The Amalgamation is dependent on a number of key steps, including approval by the members of CPA Ireland of the Amalgamation itself, and approval by members of Chartered Accountants Ireland of certain changes to its bye-laws that are necessary to implement the Amalgamation.  At present, the Amalgamation is expected to take effect on 1 September 2024.
16 September - CAP1 and CAP2 Programme enrollment deadline
20 September - CAP1 Induction
25 September - CAP1 Course Commencement
30 September - FAE Programme enrollment deadline

#### October 2024

4 October - CAP2 Induction
8 October - CAP2 Course Commencement
11 October - CPA Ireland August 2024 examination results issued. Students awaiting exam results in October will then be able to register for CAP1/ CAP2 courses
11 October - FAE Induction
23 October - FAE Course Commencement
